name: Rustman Local API Client
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed native desktop API client for HTTP and WebSocket requests, local collections and history, OpenAPI/Postman import, and pre-request/test scripts; no subscription, account, or usage quota.
watch_out: Runs on your own Windows, macOS, or Linux device; no hosted API testing infrastructure, cloud sync, or included external API usage. Scripts use Rustman's custom language rather than JavaScript; some variable substitution and import features are limited.
